blocks.text: You can schedule attendance reports for your users or workplaces for regular distribution to specified recipients. For example, you can schedule the monthly attendance report of your IT department in San Jose. The scheduled reports are emailed as links to the recipients.
Workplace reports provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Schedule reports for various criteria and distribute them to your choice of email recipients.
Frequently generate attendance reports organized based on users or workplaces.

blocks.text: On the Workplace Reports page (Analytics > Reports > Workplace Reports), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of all configured scheduled reports. For each report, you can view:
Report Name: The name of the scheduled report.
Summary: A brief summary of the report. This is autogenerated based on the scheduled report.
Next Run: The date when the next report is scheduled to be generated.
Modify the table and its columns.
Enable or disable the scheduled report.
